timeline.summary: Four Strixhaven students are led astray by a mysterious faerie and fall through an Omenpath onto Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, disturbing the balance between its two aspects.
timeline.quote: Four Strixhaven students are led astray by a mysterious faerie , and fall through an Omenpath onto the plane of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The students make new friends and recruit another student, and the faerie is revealed to be the long-lost brother of Maralen.
timeline.quote: The faerie turns out to be the long-lost brother of the fae queen Maralen .

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A party of fourth-year Strixhaven students tracks down and defeats Murgaxor Grenshel in the fortress basement.
timeline.quote: This is where Murgaxor Grenshel was tracked down and defeated by a party of fourth-year Strixhaven students.
